title: Pilot Content
help: Plans the shop's posts on Facebook and Instagram: photos or a video at the highest quality, a caption the AI writes, posted by itself at the chosen time. Each post is linked to its product, so Pilot Comments answers its comments with the right price.

plan.demo: Demo: a pretend Page and Instagram account, nothing is posted.
plan.upcomingNone: Nothing planned yet. Press « New post », or click a day.
plan.addHere: Add a post on this day

pb.empty: Add a photo, a video or a text.
pb.igPhoto: Instagram needs a photo or a video.
pb.when: Choose the day and the hour.
pb.past: Choose a time to come, or press « Post now ».
pb.mix: A post holds photos or one video, not both.
pb.storyOne: A story has one photo or one video.
pb.storyLong: Story: {{max}} seconds of video at most.
pb.tall: Instagram: a photo is too tall for a post (4:5 at most). Make it a story, or change the photo.

ed.fbOff: No Facebook Page is linked to this shop yet
ed.igOff: No Instagram account is linked to the Page yet
ed.linkHint: Link the shop's Facebook Page and its Instagram in
ed.photosHint: 1 to 10 photos. Pilotix always keeps them at the highest quality Instagram takes (up to 1440 px wide) and sends that very file when the post goes out. Instagram needs at least one photo, and gives them all the shape of the first one.
ed.small: A photo is small (under {{w}} px wide): it may look blurry. Use the original photo if you can.
ed.photoBad: This photo can't be read. Send it as JPEG or PNG (an iPhone's HEIC photos don't work).
ed.cropped: A photo was cut to fit Instagram (between 4:5 and 1.91:1).
ed.productHint: The AI writes about it, and CM AI answers the post's comments with its price.
ed.caption: Text
ed.exampleHint: Pilot AI is off: the example is made from the product's name and price.
ed.igNoEdit: Instagram lets no app change a posted text. Facebook does: change it here, then save.
ed.bestN: {{n}} orders at this hour in the last 60 days
ed.going: It is going out now: it takes up to a minute.
ed.notPosted: Not out everywhere: the post shows why
ed.videoHint: Your original video goes up untouched, at its highest quality: a Reel on Instagram, a video on Facebook. MP4 or MOV, 3 seconds to 15 minutes, 300 MB at most.
ed.videoBad: This video can't be read. Send an MP4 or MOV file.
ed.videoType: Send the video as MP4 or MOV.
ed.videoBig: Video too big: Instagram takes 300 MB at most.
ed.videoShort: Video too short: Instagram asks for 3 seconds at least.
ed.videoLong: Video too long: Instagram takes 15 minutes at most.
ed.videoLost: The video didn't get through. Try again.
ed.mixNo: A post holds photos or one video, not both.
ed.oneVideo: One video per post: the first one is kept.
ed.preparingIg: Instagram is preparing the video: it goes out in a few minutes.
ed.asked: Sent to the admin for approval.
ed.againOk: A new draft with the same photos and new words.
ed.againNoMedia: A new draft with new words: add the photos again (Pilotix keeps them one week).
ed.againHint: The same post comes back as a draft with new words
ed.storyHint: A story: one photo or one video (60 seconds at most), tall 9:16 is best. It stays 24 hours, with no caption.
ed.reviewAdmin: This post waits for your yes. Approve it to plan it, or send it back with a word.
ed.reviewWait: Waiting for the admin's yes. You can still change it.

kindHint.post: Photos, carousel or video, with a caption

ed.fcHint: Pilotix writes it under the post right after it goes out: how to order, the price in message…

plan.dragHint: Drag a post onto a day of the calendar to plan it there.

mv.past: Pick a day still to come.

ev.approx: the moon may move it by a day

idea.newyear: New Year is coming: a nice idea to start the year
idea.yennayer: Yennayer is coming: wish « Assegas Amegas » and show the product
idea.valentine: Valentine's Day is coming: a gift idea, order now to get it before 14 February
idea.women: 8 March is coming: a gift idea for the women of the family
idea.ramadan: Ramadan is coming: get ready, order before, delivery everywhere
idea.fitr: Eid al-Fitr is coming: order now to be delivered before Eid
idea.adha: Eid al-Adha is coming: order now to be delivered before Eid
idea.hijri: Islamic New Year: wish the family a happy year
idea.achoura: Ashura is coming: a warm post for the family
idea.mawlid: Mawlid is coming: a warm post, a gift idea for the children
idea.independence: 5 July, Independence Day: a post proud of Algeria
idea.school: Back to school is coming: get ready without stress, order now
idea.revolution: 1 November, Revolution Day: a post proud of Algeria
idea.blackfriday: Black Friday: the right moment to order this product

fill.title: Fill my week
fill.intro: The AI prepares a week of posts for you. You check them, then plan them in one click.

how.best: Your best sellers of the last 30 days
how.quiet: The products nobody saw lately (3 weeks)
how.event: The Algerian days coming (Ramadan, Eid, Black Friday…)

fill.onSlots: They go on your fixed times: {{times}} (Settings).
fill.onBest: They go at your best hour: {{h}}.
fill.done: {{n}} drafts are on your calendar. Look at them, then plan them.
fill.later: I'll check them one by one
fill.noPhotos: Some drafts have no photo yet (Instagram needs one): open them to add photos.

score.label: Score {{n}} out of 10
score.title: Post score
score.sub: {{n}} things to make it sell better
score.fixed: Fixed. Read it once before planning.

k.hook: A first line that stops the thumb

how.caption: Fix it adds it
how.hour: Fix it picks a good hour

res.title: Results
res.help: Meta's numbers for each post, and the orders each post brought through its comments and messages.
res.noInsights: Views and reach come once Meta allows them. Likes and comments already show.
res.permAdmin: Views and reach need 2 Meta permissions: instagram_manage_insights and read_insights. Add them to the app's review, then press « Continue with Facebook » in Accounts. Likes and comments already show.
res.note: Orders: those that came from a post's comments (Pilot Comments's private message, then Pilot Message).

tip.hour: Your posts do best around {{hour}}: plan more at that time.
tip.type: {{type}} works best for you: post more of them.
tip.quiet: {{n}} products had no post for 3 weeks.
tip.event: {{event}} in {{days}} days: prepare its posts now.
tip.more: Only {{n}} posts this week: 1 a day sells more.
tip.insights: Add the 2 Meta permissions to see the views and reach.

res.none: No post out in this period.
res.whenHelp: Average likes, comments, shares and saves per post, by the hour and the day it went out.
res.vsStart: since the start of the period

set.slotsHelp: Fill my week and Next free time use these times.
set.slotsSub: Pick the days and the hour. Algeria's evening (19:00-22:00) sells most.
set.noSlots: No fixed time: the best hour from your orders is used.
set.approval: The admin says yes before a marketer's post goes out
set.approvalHint: A marketer's planned post waits in « To approve ». The admin approves it, or sends it back with a word.
set.fcHint: Written under the post right after it goes out (the editor starts with this text).
